I created the game as a single file, `snake_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-5_01.html`, about 620 lines of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser or played it. The only check I ran was a script over the file that exited cleanly. I don't know what it tested, because the output was just "0".

What I asked it to build:
- **Grid and rules:** a 30x30 grid. Snakes move continuously, grow when they eat food, and the game ends if a snake hits a wall or itself.
- **Modes:** human vs human, CPU vs human, and CPU vs CPU, chosen from the start menu.
- **CPU snake:** it searches for food automatically.
- **Screens and scores:** scores show during play, and there are start-menu and game-over screens.
- **Controls:** keyboard controls for the human players. You can restart with a keypress from the game-over screen.

The exact key bindings and the CPU pathfinding method are in the file. I didn't list them here because I haven't read the generated code back.

To play it, open the file in any browser.

Requirements: 30x30 grid on a canvas (600x600, 20px cells); two snakes always (P1 green, P2 blue/orange), continuous movement on a tick (~110ms), grows when eating food (keep 2 food items), dies on wall or self collision or hitting the other snake (head-to-head both die). Start menu with 3 modes selectable by keys 1/2/3 and clickable buttons: Human vs Human (P1 WASD, P2 arrow keys), CPU vs Human (human P1 uses WASD or arrows both; CPU is P2), CPU vs CPU. CPU AI: BFS to nearest food avoiding walls and bodies; fall back to the safe neighbor with most free space (flood fill) if no path; prefer moves that keep a path to own tail. Prevent 180-degree reversals, queue up to 2 inputs per tick. Live scoreboard above the canvas showing both scores and alive state. Game ends when both snakes dead (a snake that dies stays dead while the other continues; its body is removed/grayed). Game over screen overlay showing winner (higher score / draw) and final scores, with 'Press Enter or Space to restart same mode' and 'Press M / Esc for menu'. Also P to pause. Dark styled modern look, centered, with controls help text. Clean, well-commented code."}
